title: Monomial on the free coordinates
statement: Let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates among $n$, let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$, and let $y$ and $z$ be sign assignments on the coordinates in and outside $J$, respectively. Combine these assignments into an assignment on all $n$ coordinates. The monomial on the image of $S$ among the original coordinates, evaluated at the combined assignment, equals the monomial on $S$ evaluated at $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates among $n$
